key_insight: Crab is a semantics-aware C/R runtime that checkpoints only the agent-visible and correctness-critical OS/runtime state, achieving per-turn correctness at a fraction of the cost of full-system snapshots while preserving application-level efficiency.
problem_solved: Enables correct, low-overhead checkpoint-and-restore for autonomous agents running in sandboxed containers and microVMs — supporting fault tolerance, spot execution, RL rollout branching, and safe rollback without the heavy cost of full per-turn snapshots or the incompleteness of application-only recovery.
method: Semantics-aware instrumentation: track agent-visible effects and classify OS/runtime artifacts (files, processes, IPC, kernel-visible state) by their relevance to agent semantics and correctness.

Selective incremental C/R: capture only the correctness-critical subset of sandbox state with differential snapshots, copy-on-write/dedup, and lazy materialization to minimize I/O, storage, and pause time.

Runtime integration for branching & fast restore: expose lightweight branching primitives and fast restore paths to support dense co-location, RL rollouts, and rapid safe rollback in production agent sandboxes.
impact: Makes frequent, correct checkpointing practical for ML practitioners building autonomous agents, reducing latency, storage and compute costs while enabling robust experimentation (branching/rollouts) and production safety (fault tolerance, rollback).
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: Crab runtime placed between agent framework and sandbox (container/microVM) showing instrumentation, selective capture, and restore paths.
Cost vs. correctness chart: compare application-level recovery, full per-turn snapshots, and Crab (low cost + high correctness).
Sequence diagram: per-turn checkpoint → branching for RL rollout → fast restore to demonstrate workflow and latency improvements.
State-stack visualization: layered view of agent-visible state (chat/history, in-memory artifacts, files, kernel resources) with highlighted subset that Crab captures.
paper_title: Crab: A Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore Runtime for Agent Sandboxes
paper_authors: Tianyuan Wu, Chaokun Chang, Lunxi Cao, Wei Gao, Wei Wang
